w:r.w:t: Small Shopify merchants spend significant time on repetitive operational tasks such as:
The objective is to automate these repetitive workflows while giving the merchant a centralized dashboard.
Build a production-quality SaaS prototype that:
Connects to a Shopify Development Store
Uses AI to generate product descriptions
Must satisfy every KPI from the assignment.
One failure must not stop others.
AI-powered reorder suggestions based on inventory trends.
Daily email summary of store health.
WebSocket live updates for inventory and orders.
AI chatbot that answers questions like "Which products are low on stock?" using your application's own data.
